ops.text: CORRECTION to papercut 0bbbe138: `uv sync --reinstall-package cc-transcript` is NOT a reliable native-rebuild — it reinstalls the CACHED same-version wheel (verified: a repo venv stayed stale through it, still missing new pyfunctions). It only appeared to work in the p2-ids worktree because the build cache happened to miss there. The reliable forced rebuild for the path dep is `uv sync --refresh-package cc-transcript` (invalidates the build cache; matches the original release-mechanics memory) or `maturin develop` (always recompiles). Additionally: every lane gate should run a freshness canary before trusting pytest — assert a recently-added symbol exists (e.g. python -c "import cc_transcript._parser_rs as m; assert hasattr(m, 'ids_tool_digest')") — because stale builds fail as confusing parity AttributeErrors. Landed-gate audit: both the ids and toolcall landing gates were implicitly fresh (their parity suites exercise the new symbols and passed).
